milestones.name: Phase 1 — BambooHR Interface (read-through)
milestones.note: Decision 2026-07-30 (Jon): HR is STRICTLY an interface to BambooHR. Bamboo stays the system of record — no absorption, no cutover. MC displays a read-through mirror only; HR PII stays in Bamboo (out of ExoMac scope).

deliverables.name: HR read-through cache schema (org, position, employee)
deliverables.note: employee/org_unit/position live via audited DAL; serves as the Bamboo mirror (placeholder org seeded until the sync runs)

deliverables.name: BambooHR interface adapter (directory + org sync)
deliverables.note: adapter BUILT (erp-foundation/bamboo_sync.js) — runs on BAMBOO_SUBDOMAIN + BAMBOO_API_KEY; read-only, never writes back to Bamboo, no PII

deliverables.name: HR directory / org-chart views in MC (read-only)
deliverables.note: renders from the Bamboo mirror; deep-links to Bamboo for authoritative HR actions

milestones.name: Phase 2 — Timekeeping (Bamboo/DCAA) → MC Cost Accounting
milestones.note: Decision 2026-07-30: timekeeping lives in BAMBOO — projects structured to the DCAA-required format, employees book time under DCAA cost codes, Bamboo object-lock = immutability. Fixed-Price (FFP) is the primary vehicle, which limits the DCAA compliance burden. MC does NOT build timekeeping; it reads Bamboo actuals for cost rollup.

deliverables.name: DCAA timekeeping (in Bamboo — projects + cost codes + object-lock)
deliverables.note: configured in BambooHR, not built in MC; FFP-primary limits the compliance scope

deliverables.name: Read Bamboo project/time actuals into MC (interface)
deliverables.note: bamboo_sync.js extends to pull projects + time entries when the API key lands

deliverables.name: Labor actuals → project / WBS cost rollup (feeds Phase 4)

milestones.name: Phase 3 — BambooHR Cutover & Decommission
milestones.note: Removed by decision 2026-07-30 — BambooHR remains the HR system of record permanently; MC interfaces to it, never replaces it.

deliverables.name: N/A — Bamboo stays authoritative (no cutover/decommission)
deliverables.note: superseded by the read-through interface in Phase 1
